name: Tychicus
title: Paul's Faithful Messenger
summary: Tychicus was a faithful coworker and messenger of the apostle Paul. He came from the province of Asia and was known for delivering letters and encouragement to the churches. Paul described him as a beloved brother, a faithful servant, and a fellow worker in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Journey with Paul to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Tychicus was one of the representatives from Asia who accompanied Paul on his final journey to Jerusalem with the collection for the poor.

keyEvents.title: Bearer of the Letter to the Ephesians
keyEvents.description: Paul sent Tychicus with the letter to the Ephesians to tell them about his situation and encourage them. Paul called him a beloved brother and a faithful servant in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Bearer of the Letter to the Colossians
keyEvents.description: Together with Onesimus, Tychicus was sent to Colossae to deliver Paul's letter and tell the church how the apostle was doing.

keyEvents.title: Possible Mission to Crete or Ephesus
keyEvents.description: Paul planned to send either Artemas or Tychicus to Titus in Crete, showing the trust Paul had in him as a leader.

keyEvents.title: Sent to Ephesus
keyEvents.description: In his last known letter, Paul mentions that he has sent Tychicus to Ephesus, probably to continue the ministry there.
